title: Search Before You Build — rich
forward_vector: I am the manifest of Search Before You Build's rich face: what was made for each section, and the fingerprint of the words each piece was made against, so the page can say when a piece may lag the text. I grow when the entry is enriched again; I never hold the entry's words.
note: A light face, from the second light round (2026-11-17): one small thing beside one sentence. Made as if it were the only page: one maker who read the page whole, one challenger who was given nothing of the maker's reasoning, one remake, and a second verdict by the same challenger. Made in Enrichment/light-round-2026-11-2/pieces/Search Before You Build/, where the script, the job and its provenance stay; placed here by the Concierge, with what made it copied from that provenance and not guessed. Loudon approved the line it was made from ("Yes, make them", 2026-11-17, relayed by the working session) and has not seen or heard the finished piece. The section is a proposal until he approves it.

verdicts.file: Search Before You Build — rich — the same flat depth, eight days earlier.png
verdicts.why: Of the first version, "upstream", which stays in the workshop: the dates were right, but the headline said the bracket was rewritten when the depth pass was written without it; half the picture was two plates that look the same unstretched; about 75 words at 11 to 13 px; inputs were not hashed. The challenger offered a better piece, that no prose named the bracket until 9 July.

remade.file: Search Before You Build — rich — the same flat depth, eight days earlier.png
remade.what: The maker checked the offered claim before drawing it and it did not hold as stated: a Shop gotcha named the range on 13 June, three commit messages named the symptom on 1 July, and the bracket was in four files from 13 June, not three from 14 June. A new piece draws the narrower thing that does hold: no page warned of the flat before 9 July. After the second verdict, three small edits it asked for were applied by the maker and seen by the working session, with no third verdict, as the challenger said none was needed: a caption phrase, the 1 July code mark drawn as a square labelled subject_depth_range(), and the Figure Rig fact checked, three parts holding and one not.
remade.second_verdict: keep: Keep, after three small edits. The challenger confirmed it had been wrong on both points: its own variant search had failed without saying so. All recomputed and matching, by a broader search than the maker's. Now a join, not a repeat: the lesson sits in code and in commit words and in no page until the day of the fix, which is the page's Forward Vectors sentence.

pieces.title: The same flat depth, 8 days earlier
pieces.caption: The miss had happened before. On 1 July the same flat depth was found and fixed in another project, and three commit messages said so in plain words. No page did. A builder reading the pages on 9 July would have found nothing that warned of it. A builder who also read the commits would have.
